limitations.limitation: Detection is outcome-differential. Hidden state that is read without changing the normalised exit code, stdout or stderr is not detected.
limitations.evidence: Fixture silent-hidden-state-dependency reads an untracked file and still returns NO_HIDDEN_STATE_DEPENDENCY_DETECTED; recorded as known_false_negative in fixture-matrix-result.json and asserted by test_silent_hidden_state_read_is_a_documented_false_negative.

limitations.limitation: The nondeterminism control depends on repeating each side at least twice. At repeats=1 an intrinsically flaky command can be reported as a hidden-state finding.
limitations.evidence: test_determinism_control_requires_more_than_one_run_per_side. A workload flaky at a rate below the repeat count can also evade the control; the residual escape rate is NOT_MEASURED.

limitations.limitation: Per-side path normalisation deliberately masks location-only differences, so dependence on an absolute path is detected only when it changes the outcome beyond the path text itself.
limitations.evidence: MC-PO03-WA-008-01; the same normalisation is what prevents a false positive when the two checkouts sit at different locations.

limitations.limitation: classification_digest covers the command, which in every run here contains the absolute interpreter path, so digests are host-scoped. Recurrence claims hold for the same interpreter location, not across hosts.
limitations.evidence: Fixture commands are built with sys.executable, observed as /usr/bin/python3 with CPython 3.12.3.

limitations.limitation: Attribution probes copy contaminating files with shutil.copy2, which preserves mode and mtime but not ownership or extended attributes. A cache whose validity depends on ownership, xattrs or inode identity may not be faithfully reconstructed, which would understate rather than overstate a finding.
limitations.evidence: NOT_MEASURED; no fixture exercises xattr- or ownership-sensitive caches.

limitations.limitation: Modified tracked content and checkout ref state are reported but never attributed, because the frozen hypothesis names only untracked files, environment leakage and warm caches.
limitations.evidence: Fixtures unattributed-git-ref-state and unattributed-modified-tracked-file; widening is proposed as SP-PO03-WA-008-02, not performed here.

limitations.limitation: Cache classification is glob-based. A cache stored outside the declared globs and outside the XDG cache root is classified as an untracked file, so the class label can be wrong even when detection is right.
limitations.evidence: DEFAULT_CACHE_GLOBS in differential_run.py; the classes are disjoint by construction with cache globs taking precedence, asserted by test_cache_and_untracked_classes_are_disjoint.

limitations.limitation: Environment values are recorded only as SHA-256 digests and lengths, so a leaked value cannot be inspected from the artefact.

Cost scales with one independent clone per side and per probe. This was measured only on a repository whose clone is about 1.5 MiB; behaviour on a large repository or a shallow or partial clone is unmeasured.
limitations.evidence: Three-scenario repository-native reproduction completed in about 3.6 s; the 11-fixture matrix in about 5.6 s.

limitations.limitation: The live-checkout census compares path membership against a commit tree only; it does not measure content differences or environment state in that checkout, and it executes nothing there.
limitations.evidence: live-checkout-census.json records ENVIRONMENT_LEAKAGE as NOT_MEASURED_NO_EXECUTION_IN_THIS_CHECKOUT. The compared commit affc82b is not an ancestor of the live checkout's HEAD 65335a4; the two histories diverge, so the census is a comparison against the attempt's base, not against that checkout's own HEAD.

limitations.limitation: Every result here is from one Linux host with git 2.43.0 and CPython 3.12.3. Windows, macOS, alternative git object formats and container-boundary effects are NOT_SUPPORTED by this evidence.
No external documentation, paper, practitioner repository or postmortem was retrieved; no web retrieval route was exposed to this runner. No current-method external hypothesis is claimed.
limitations.evidence: source-claims.json external_network_retrieval NOT_SUPPORTED. The immutable input sets minimum_current_method_hypotheses to 0 for this attempt.

limitations.limitation: The reasoning setting actually applied by the provider is not separately attested to this runner; only the model family is observable from the runtime.
limitations.evidence: model_observed is claude-opus-5 as self-reported by the runtime; reasoning_observed is NOT_SUPPORTED against the requested claude-opus-5-thinking-high.

limitations.limitation: This unit is not independently accepted. The producer reports READY_TO_COMMIT only, does not set COMPLETED, and cannot accept its own result.
limitations.evidence: ready-to-commit.json records completion_actor null and independent_acceptance NOT_TESTED.

limitations.limitation: The differential runner was applied to the seeded PO-03 workloads and to a fast subset of this unit's own tests, not to the unit's full 28-test suite as a differential workload, because the suite itself spawns the fixture matrix and the nested cost was judged not worth the evidence.
limitations.evidence: tests.json self_application records the subset actually run under differential comparison.
